instruction: Pull over beside the dark car parked on the left.
paraphrases: Stop next to the dark car on the left.|Park beside the left-hand dark car.

instruction: Pass the white car on the left, then stop near the dark car ahead.
paraphrases: Go past the left-hand white car and stop by the dark car in front.|After the white car on the left, pull over near the dark car ahead.

instruction: Stop behind the white car ahead, not the dark car on the left.
paraphrases: Take the white car in front rather than the dark car on the left.|Pull over behind the white car ahead instead of the left-hand dark car.
